label: Cohort size
definition: Eligible adults offered the intervention
notes: Scaling choice only; ITT values are per person offered.

label: Analysis horizon
definition: Years after enrollment included in the core model
notes: No terminal value in the core model.

label: Price year
definition: Common dollar year for costs and benefits
notes: All dollar outputs are 2025 dollars.

label: Real discount rate
definition: Annual real rate used to convert future flows to present value
notes: Reference 3%; conservative 7%; Monte Carlo spans 0-7%.

label: Simulation draws
definition: Number of Monte Carlo draws
notes: Large enough for stable decision probabilities while remaining fast.

label: Random seed
definition: Seed for deterministic Monte Carlo reproduction
notes: Changing the seed changes draws but not assumptions.

label: CPI 2018
definition: Annual average CPI-U seasonally adjusted

label: CPI 2020
definition: Annual average CPI-U seasonally adjusted

label: CPI 2021
definition: Annual average CPI-U seasonally adjusted

label: CPI 2022
definition: Annual average CPI-U seasonally adjusted

label: CPI 2023
definition: Annual average CPI-U seasonally adjusted

label: CPI 2025
definition: Annual average CPI-U seasonally adjusted
transformation: mean of 11 available nonmissing monthly observations
notes: October 2025 is missing in the retrieved series; the effect on the price factor is immaterial.

label: Reference completion
definition: Sample-weighted WorkAdvance training completion rate
transformation: weighted by site program and control sample
notes: Benchmark only; ITT effects already embody completion.

label: Utah assumed completion
definition: Utah reference-case training completion rate
notes: Provider data enter through a versioned parameter update.

label: Completion-cost elasticity
definition: Elasticity of training-related cost with respect to completion
notes: Completion affects variable training cost; fixed costs remain.

label: Completion-outcome elasticity
definition: Elasticity used only when translating away from benchmark completion
notes: Reference is zero to avoid double attenuation of an ITT estimate.

label: Program cost multiplier
definition: Multiplier on the evidence-weighted net incremental program cost
notes: Distribution field dist_max stores coefficient of variation for lognormal parameters.

label: Training cost share
definition: Share of gross program cost linked to occupational and work-based training
notes: Used to vary cost with completion while keeping other components fixed.

label: Utah wage translation factor
definition: Multiplier applied to WorkAdvance earnings impacts
notes: Reference does not mechanically scale causal effects by local wages; Utah wages shape targeting and counterfactuals.

label: Years 1-6 effect CV
definition: Coefficient of variation for shared uncertainty on early earnings impacts
notes: Used as a normal multiplicative factor centered at one and truncated at zero.

label: Annual effect correlation
definition: Common correlation among adjacent long-term effect draws
notes: Prevents implausibly independent annual treatment effects.

label: Fringe benefit rate
definition: Employer-paid nonwage compensation as share of incremental earnings
transformation: MDRC assumption with BLS upper anchor
notes: Reference follows MDRC. BLS ECEC includes legally required benefits. Employer payroll tax is therefore deducted from participant compensation under standard long-run incidence before it is credited to government.

label: Federal effective marginal tax rate
definition: Reduced-form federal income tax rate on incremental earnings
notes: Not a microsimulation; replace with tax-unit data when available.

label: Utah income tax rate
definition: Statutory Utah individual income tax rate
notes: Credits mean realized effective liability can be lower.

label: Employee payroll tax rate
definition: Employee Social Security plus Medicare rate
notes: Assumes incremental earnings below the Social Security taxable maximum.

label: Employer payroll tax rate
definition: Employer Social Security plus Medicare rate
notes: Credited to combined government and deducted from participant compensation under standard long-run incidence. It cancels as a transfer in the societal account.

label: Transfer offset rate
definition: Reduction in public transfers per dollar of incremental earnings
notes: Transparent zero is preferable to unsupported savings.

label: Participant time cost
definition: Opportunity cost per person offered recorded at enrollment
notes: Reference excludes time because attendance-hours and displaced-work data are unavailable.

label: Utah program cost share
definition: Share of incremental program cost paid by Utah government
notes: Update when federal, employer, or philanthropic matching shares are specified.

label: Minimum target wage
definition: Hard gate for target occupation median annual wage

label: Minimum annual openings
definition: Hard gate for annual projected openings

label: Demand weight
definition: Weight on growth and openings in reference target score
notes: Reference score uses observable Utah demand, wage, and access measures.

label: Wage weight
definition: Weight on wage mobility in reference target score
notes: Reference score uses observable Utah demand, wage, and access measures.

label: Accessibility weight
definition: Weight on credential accessibility in reference target score
notes: Reference score uses observable Utah demand, wage, and access measures.

label: AI resilience weight
definition: Weight on low task-level generative-AI exposure
notes: Unweighted in the reference score. Reported as a diagnostic overlay and tested only in a named AI-transition sensitivity.
